methods_proposed.name: Linear Regression
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_linear_regression(train_df, test_df, target_col, **params):
    from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
    import pandas as pd
    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    return pd.DataFrame({"predicted": model.predict(X_test)}, index=test_df.index)

methods_proposed.name: Random Forest Regressor
methods_proposed.description: Ensemble of decision trees for non-linear patterns
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_random_forest(train_df, test_df, target_col, **params):
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
    import pandas as pd
    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col])
    model = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    return pd.DataFrame({"predicted": model.predict(X_test)}, index=test_df.index)
